KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mitoto
   B. watoto
   C. mato
   D. kitoto

2. When practising Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo.

3. When practising Sarufi 2.4.1 Aina za nomino makundi dhahania, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Sarufi 2.4.1 Aina za nomino makundi dhahania.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Sarufi 2.4.1 Aina za nomino makundi dhahania.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Sarufi 2.4.1 Aina za nomino makundi dhahania.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Sarufi 2.4.1 Aina za nomino makundi dhahania.

4. When practising Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo.

5. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. nene
   B. fupi
   C. zito
   D. pana

6. When practising Kuandika 1.3.1 Viakifishi kubwa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kuandika 1.3.1 Viakifishi kubwa.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Kuandika 1.3.1 Viakifishi kubwa.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Kuandika 1.3.1 Viakifishi kubwa.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Kuandika 1.3.1 Viakifishi kubwa.

7. When practising Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia.

8. When practising Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 2.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /dh/ na /th/, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 2.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /dh/ na /th/.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 2.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /dh/ na /th/.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 2.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /dh/ na /th/.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 2.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /dh/ na /th/.

9. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   C. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   D. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.

10. When practising Kuandika 2.3.1 Barua ya Kirafiki ya Kutoa Mwaliko, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Kuandika 2.3.1 Barua ya Kirafiki ya Kutoa Mwaliko.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Kuandika 2.3.1 Barua ya Kirafiki ya Kutoa Mwaliko.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Kuandika 2.3.1 Barua ya Kirafiki ya Kutoa Mwaliko.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kuandika 2.3.1 Barua ya Kirafiki ya Kutoa Mwaliko.

11. When practising Sarufi 1.4.1 Aina za nomino pekee kawaida, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Sarufi 1.4.1 Aina za nomino pekee kawaida.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Sarufi 1.4.1 Aina za nomino pekee kawaida.

12. When practising Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha simulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha simulizi.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha simulizi.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha simulizi.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha simulizi.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Nyimbo za watoto and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Kusoma 4.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Kuandika 4.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Sarufi 4.4.1 Nyakati na Hali; uliopo uliopita and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — watoto

2. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo.

3. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Sarufi 2.4.1 Aina za nomino makundi dhahania.

4. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo.

5. B — fupi

6. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kuandika 1.3.1 Viakifishi kubwa.

7. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia.

8. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 2.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /dh/ na /th/.

9. A — Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

10. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kuandika 2.3.1 Barua ya Kirafiki ya Kutoa Mwaliko.

11. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Sarufi 1.4.1 Aina za nomino pekee kawaida.

12. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha simulizi.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Nyimbo za watoto; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Kusoma 4.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Kuandika 4.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Masimulizi; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Sarufi 4.4.1 Nyakati na Hali; uliopo uliopita; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
